name: Build a Fully Immersive VR Game

vr_game_setup.hook: Before any gameplay, what's the base you build a VR game on?
vr_game_setup.recall: What's the base for a VR game in Unity?
vr_game_setup.answer: Unity + Meta XR SDK + an XR rig + a game loop

game_loop.hook: Every game is one thing repeated 72 times a second. What?
game_loop.answer: the per-frame cycle of input -> update -> render

core_mechanic.hook: Every great game has ONE central verb. What's a 'mechanic'?
core_mechanic.recall: What is a core game mechanic?
core_mechanic.answer: the central repeated action the game is built around (grab, shoot, climb...)

physics_interaction.hook: Why does grabbing and throwing feel real in a good VR game?
physics_interaction.recall: Why does physics matter in a VR game?
physics_interaction.answer: grab/throw/collide feel real when driven by the physics engine (rigidbodies + colliders)

enemy_ai.hook: An enemy that just stands there is boring. How do you give it 'intelligence'?
enemy_ai.recall: How do simple enemy AIs work?
enemy_ai.answer: a state machine (idle -> chase -> attack) + pathfinding toward the player

game_feel.hook: Two games, identical rules — one feels amazing, one flat. What's the difference?
game_feel.answer: feedback polish — hit-stop, particles, haptics, sound, shake — that makes actions satisfying

spawning_levels.hook: How do you fill a level with enemies/items that scale in difficulty?
spawning_levels.recall: How do you build levels / spawn content?
spawning_levels.answer: prefabs + spawners + a difficulty curve across levels

game_audio.hook: Mute a great VR game and it dies. Why?
game_audio.recall: Role of audio + spatial sound in a VR game?
game_audio.answer: spatial SFX + music drive immersion and tell the player what's happening

score_save.hook: A high score nobody can beat tomorrow is no fun. How do you keep it?
score_save.answer: PlayerPrefs / JSON + a scoring system saved across sessions

vr_game_perf.hook: A laggy VR game makes players sick. What's the bar?
vr_game_perf.recall: Performance target for a VR game?
vr_game_perf.answer: hold 72fps — batch draw calls, optimize textures + poly count

ship_vr_game.hook: It's fun and runs well — now get it to players. How?
ship_vr_game.recall: How do you ship a VR game?
ship_vr_game.answer: Meta dev account, signed APK, store listing, submit for review
